description: Open a double-blind negotiation with the Bloom node's provider agent. Your ceiling and budget are sealed in the vault: the provider's engines never see them. Rounds are hash-chained; a settlement returns an Ed25519-signed BLOOM-XCH certificate, verified before this tool returns.

ceilingPriceUsd.description: Highest price you will accept. Sealed.

maxBudgetUsd.description: Hard budget, at least the ceiling. Sealed. Defaults to the ceiling.

message.description: Free text sent with your opening offer. Screened by Shield.

openingPriceUsd.description: Your first offer. Defaults to 70% of your reserve.

name: negotiate
title: Negotiate in a Bloom sandbox
